name: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol
summary: Signature-based framework (Oct 2025) letting merchants verify trusted commerce agents, distinguish them from malicious bots and receive consumer and payment context.
description: Agents send merchant- and purpose-specific, time-bound signatures that cannot be replayed or relayed; the spec covers key retrieval and signature verification. Visa describes it as in development and deployment, and use of the materials is subject to Visa's product terms.
